cues.en: Hello, I'm Photonov Skupx. This is a very simple Amiga Hardware assembler programming tutorial. What you see on the screen is ASM1, which I find a very nice and complete development environment. At the start it asks how much memory you want to allocate for your source codes and your included binary files and so on. Entering the amount of memory
cues.zh: 你好，我是 Photonov Skupx。这是一个非常简单的 Amiga 硬件汇编器编程教程。屏幕上看到的是 ASM1，我觉得它是个很好用、很完整的开发环境。启动时它会问你，想为源代码、包含的二进制文件等分配多少内存。输入内存大小

cues.en: gives you a command prompt which has one and two letter commands that does all the things up here in the menus. The development environment includes an editor, debugger and monitor and I will show you only the command line commands because the menus are self-explanatory. To enter the editor press escape. This is your editor window.
cues.zh: 就会给你一个命令提示符，里面有一到两个字母的命令，可以完成上面菜单里的所有操作。这个开发环境包括编辑器、调试器和监视器；我只演示命令行命令，因为菜单本身一目了然。按 Esc 进入编辑器。这就是你的编辑器窗口。

cues.en: you write your code here. The first thing we're going to do is write a busy loop, a busy wait loop that waits for the left mouse button to be pressed and then exits the little program, goes back to the assembler. This is a label. To test the left mouse button, you test bit 6 in this register in the CIA input output ports. Like most
cues.zh: 你在这里写代码。我们要做的第一件事是写一个忙循环，也就是忙等待循环，等待鼠标左键被按下，然后退出这个小程序，回到汇编器。这是一个标签。要检测鼠标左键，就检测 CIA 输入/输出端口中这个寄存器的第 6 位。和大多数

cues.en: click the left mouse button and then you're presented with a nice little register value list with the data register values and the address register values including the stack pointer, the user stack pointer which is address register 7. That's all there is to it. In the next tutorial we will change a scan line on the screen until left mouse button is pressed.
cues.zh: 点击鼠标左键，然后就会看到一个不错的小型寄存器值列表，里面有数据寄存器的值和地址寄存器的值，包括栈指针，也就是地址寄存器 7 的用户栈指针。就这么简单。在下一个教程中，我们会改变屏幕上的一条扫描线，直到鼠标左键被按下。
